'''Pol Virten''' was a male [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] thief who, upon stealing a number of [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] from a museum, aspired to become a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].

Apart from his real form, which he rarely assumed, Virten was known to [[Changeling/Legends|transform]] into both an arrogant-looking [[Human/Legends|Human]] male and an [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]].

==History==
Pol Virten made his way through life on burlgary, using his [[Species/Legends|species's]] shapeshifting abilities to infiltrate secure locations and walk away with whatever he could get his hands on. Virten knew that he was special, and when he discovered that he could [[Telekinesis/Legends|move objects]] just by concentrating on them, he knew that he had a special destiny--as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

While in his human guise, he took a job for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Draba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], liberating a handful of [[Sith artifact/Legends|relics]] from a museum in the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. Before he could deliver them to his employer, however, Virten began to have dreams in which he was a full-fledged Sith Lord, ruling an [[Sith Empire/Legends|empire]] where Hutts feared and respected him, rather than the other way around. Virten was quick to deduce that the dreams had originated from one of the artifacts he had stolen--a fragment of an ancient [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]]--and decided to seize his opportunity for greatness, betraying Draba. He then sold all but two of the artifacts--the aforementioned holocron and a malfunctioning [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]]--to finance his new empire.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

Draba, who remained ignorant of both his treacherous employee's Clawdite nature and Sith inclinations, posted a 100,000 credit [[Bounty/Legends|reward]] for anyone who could bring Pol Virten in alive--if only so that the Hutt might have the pleasure of making his death as unbearable as possible. Virten was unperturbed, and in fact pleased by this turn of events; he ''wanted'' the [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] to send [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] after him, so that he might test his new abilities. However, realizing that his skills were not on par with those of the ancient Sith Lords--and that the hunters could still beat him through sheer weight of numbers--Virten spread rumors of him being on over a dozen worlds to throw off the scent, using the time this bought him to learn new powers from the artifacts.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

===Shootout on Nar Shaddaa===
Eventually, a band of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] tracked the self-styled Sith Lord to the famous [[Kessel Club]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where they engaged Virten and his eight bodyguards in a protracted battle over one of the Vertical City's many urban canyons. During the skirmish, he transformed into an Aqualish and ducked into a crowd of civilians in an attempt to catch his would-be captors in a cunning sneak attack, before attempting to flee to his personal shuttle.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
